_comment: Shared-model manifest for gen_catalog.py. Maps an app id to the SHARED model files it needs dropped into a device directory (target_path) at install time -- for apps whose package does NOT bundle the model (one-gen models[]+target_path parity). Files are staged under <models-dir>/<app_id>/<filename> (default market/packaging/models/<app_id>/). gen_catalog hashes the real staged bytes; nothing here is hand-written except the file list + target_path. Apps absent from this map get models: [] (their model is bundled inside the package).
